title: Friends and neighbors stand against me; conscience as accuser
english: My friends and my neighbors drew near against me and stood (Psalm 38:11 (LXX 37:11)). The faithful one, weak, groans over his offenses; the accusing conscience is with me—why do I wait for an accuser?
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 12 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via Archive PDF pdftotext; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.
After tip af40bc8a; Psalms Rufinus Homilia II in Ps 37 CLOSEOUT.
orientation: Origen is interpreting Psalm 37 (LXX 36), where the psalmist speaks of his suffering under sin and the weight of guilt.

title: Confession and seeking healing
english: Mindful of the offense, let him confess what he has committed and seek healing. Glory to God. Amen.
